profile: vectorized implementation: A way to write numerical code by replacing explicit Python for loops with numerically equivalent operations from the numpy library. This approach removes much of the inefficiency of entry-wise Python loops. As a general rule, whenever vectorized implementations are available, one must avoid implementing algebraic expressions in Python using explicit for loops.
